name: l3-ns: Linux hosts in netns on the loop netdevs; ARP/ND resolution through the traps, IP2ME pings, routed pings between two subnets [h2: cage 3 <-> 17, cage 3 behind the Credo PHY]

steps.desc: loop observer: frames to the far hosts' MACs (02:00:00:00:0a/0b:xx) to the CPU
netns h1 = Ethernet128 (10.1.0.2, fc00:1::2); Ethernet16 = 10.1.0.1 / fc00:1::1 with the RIF MAC
steps.cmd: export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip netns add l3h1 || echo "FAILED: ip netns add l3h1"; ip link set Ethernet128 netns l3h1 || echo "FAILED: ip link set Ethernet128 netns l3h1"; ip -n l3h1 link set Ethernet128 address 02:00:00:00:0a:02 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 link set Ethernet128 address 02:00:00:00:0a:02"; ip -n l3h1 link set Ethernet128 mtu 9100 up || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 link set Ethernet128 mtu 9100 up"; ip -n l3h1 link set lo up || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 link set lo up"; ip -n l3h1 addr add 10.1.0.2/24 dev Ethernet128 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 addr add 10.1.0.2/24 dev Ethernet128"; ip -n l3h1 -6 addr add fc00:1::2/64 dev Ethernet128 nodad || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 -6 addr add fc00:1::2/64 dev Ethernet128 nodad"; ip link set Ethernet16 address 02:00:00:00:01:0a || echo "FAILED: ip link set Ethernet16 address 02:00:00:00:01:0a"; ip link set Ethernet16 mtu 9100 up || echo "FAILED: ip link set Ethernet16 mtu 9100 up"; ip addr add 10.1.0.1/24 dev Ethernet16 || echo "FAILED: ip addr add 10.1.0.1/24 dev Ethernet16"; sysctl -qw net.ipv6.conf.Ethernet16.disable_ipv6=0 || echo "FAILED: sysctl disable_ipv6"; ip -6 addr add fc00:1::1/64 dev Ethernet16 nodad || echo "FAILED: ip -6 addr add fc00:1::1/64 dev Ethernet16 nodad"; ip neigh flush dev Ethernet16 || echo "FAILED: ip neigh flush dev Ethernet16"; ip -n l3h1 neigh flush dev Ethernet128 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 neigh flush dev Ethernet128"; ip -br addr show dev Ethernet16 || echo "FAILED: ip -br addr show dev Ethernet16"; ip -n l3h1 -br addr || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 -br addr"; echo done

steps.desc: h1 ping 10.1.0.1 (ARP through the ARP traps both ways, ICMP through IP2ME)
steps.cmd: export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip netns exec l3h1 ping -c 10 -i 0.2 -W 1 10.1.0.1; ip -n l3h1 neigh show; ip neigh show dev Ethernet16

steps.desc: h1 ping -6 fc00:1::1 (ND through the ND trap)
steps.cmd: export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip netns exec l3h1 ping -6 -c 10 -i 0.2 -W 1 fc00:1::1; ip -n l3h1 -6 neigh show; ip -6 neigh show dev Ethernet16

steps.desc: the kernel learnt 10.1.0.2 and fc00:1::2 on Ethernet16 (what neighsyncd turns into SAI neighbors)
steps.cmd: export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip neigh show 10.1.0.2 dev Ethernet16; ip -6 neigh show fc00:1::2 dev Ethernet16

steps.desc: h1 ping again with the SAI neighbors
steps.cmd: export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip netns exec l3h1 ping -c 10 -i 0.2 -W 1 10.1.0.1; ip netns exec l3h1 ping -6 -c 10 -i 0.2 -W 1 fc00:1::1

steps.desc: netns h2 = Ethernet16 (10.2.0.2 gw 10.2.0.1), h1 gw 10.1.0.1, static gateway MACs
steps.cmd: export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip addr flush dev Ethernet16 || echo "FAILED: ip addr flush dev Ethernet16"; ip netns add l3h2 || echo "FAILED: ip netns add l3h2"; ip link set Ethernet16 netns l3h2 || echo "FAILED: ip link set Ethernet16 netns l3h2"; ip -n l3h2 link set Ethernet16 address 02:00:00:00:0b:02 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h2 link set Ethernet16 address 02:00:00:00:0b:02"; ip -n l3h2 link set Ethernet16 mtu 9100 up || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h2 link set Ethernet16 mtu 9100 up"; ip -n l3h2 link set lo up || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h2 link set lo up"; ip -n l3h2 addr add 10.2.0.2/24 dev Ethernet16 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h2 addr add 10.2.0.2/24 dev Ethernet16"; ip -n l3h2 -6 addr add fc00:2::2/64 dev Ethernet16 nodad || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h2 -6 addr add fc00:2::2/64 dev Ethernet16 nodad"; ip -n l3h1 route add default via 10.1.0.1 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 route add default via 10.1.0.1"; ip -n l3h2 route add default via 10.2.0.1 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h2 route add default via 10.2.0.1"; ip -n l3h1 -6 route add default via fc00:1::1 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 -6 route add default via fc00:1::1"; ip -n l3h2 -6 route add default via fc00:2::1 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h2 -6 route add default via fc00:2::1"; ip -n l3h1 neigh replace 10.1.0.1 lladdr 02:00:00:00:01:0a dev Ethernet128 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 neigh replace 10.1.0.1 lladdr 02:00:00:00:01:0a dev Ethernet128"; ip -n l3h2 neigh replace 10.2.0.1 lladdr 02:00:00:00:01:0b dev Ethernet16 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h2 neigh replace 10.2.0.1 lladdr 02:00:00:00:01:0b dev Ethernet16"; ip -n l3h1 neigh replace fc00:1::1 lladdr 02:00:00:00:01:0a dev Ethernet128 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 neigh replace fc00:1::1 lladdr 02:00:00:00:01:0a dev Ethernet128"; ip -n l3h2 neigh replace fc00:2::1 lladdr 02:00:00:00:01:0b dev Ethernet16 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h2 neigh replace fc00:2::1 lladdr 02:00:00:00:01:0b dev Ethernet16"; echo done
export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip netns exec l3h1 ping -c 20 -i 0.1 -W 1 10.2.0.2
export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip netns exec l3h1 ping -6 -c 20 -i 0.1 -W 1 fc00:2::2

steps.desc: h1 -> h2 ping 8000 B, DF (RIF MTU 9100)
steps.cmd: export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip netns exec l3h1 ping -c 5 -i 0.2 -W 1 -s 8000 -M do 10.2.0.2

steps.desc: h1 -> h2 traceroute-style TTL 1 (expect no reply from h2)
steps.cmd: export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip netns exec l3h1 ping -c 3 -i 0.2 -W 1 -t 1 10.2.0.2
export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip netns exec l3h1 ping -f -c 2000 -W 1 10.2.0.2 | tail -3

steps.desc: netdevs back to the root namespace
steps.cmd: export PATH=/run/current-system/sw/bin:$PATH; ip -n l3h1 link set Ethernet128 netns 1 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h1 link set Ethernet128 netns 1"; ip -n l3h2 link set Ethernet16 netns 1 || echo "FAILED: ip -n l3h2 link set Ethernet16 netns 1"; ip netns del l3h1 || echo "FAILED: ip netns del l3h1"; ip netns del l3h2 || echo "FAILED: ip netns del l3h2"; ip -br link show Ethernet16 || echo "FAILED: ip -br link show Ethernet16"; ip -br link show Ethernet128 || echo "FAILED: ip -br link show Ethernet128"; echo done
